Name: Alternate Toddlers
Author: vampiresstrinity
Description:
I disliked seeing the children in the game forever in onesies. I liked it for the babies, but thought that toddlers would be old enough to have actual cute little outfits. As such this mod puts the boys into little colored plaid flannel shirts over a white shirt and black pants. Girls get white shirts and colored skirts. Both have white shoes. Each spouse has their own toddler pair with matching skin, eyes, hair, flannel shirt color, and skirt color.

There are also three alternate versions to cover skin types not present with any of the spouses. Adding each alt skin to every spouse would have been a chore so I just gave them shirts and skirts of some of the more common colors so they can match most of the spouses. I figured dark genes are dominant anyway so there was no real need to try to blend them with all 12 darn spouses. The pale version is meant to represent albinism so again no need to blend.

Girls also get long hair! I wasn't sure what was going on with the original girl hairstyle so now they can dart around in long, flowing locks!

Etc:

* Sam has green eyes in his sprite but blue eyes in his portrait. Since I can't tell which is his real eye color his daughter has green eyes and his son will have blue.

* I will not make matching babies. There is already a mod on the nexus for that so it is unnecessary.

* You may request an alternate skin and if enough people express interest in the same skin I will likely make it. I will not make alternate versions that match each spouse for it is simply more work than I am willing to put into virtual toddlers.

* All .png image files are included so you can make your own edits.

~Installation~
1. Backup Toddler.xnb and Toddler_girl.xnb in Content/Characters
2. Copy ONE mod version of Toddler.xnb and Toddler_girl.xnb into Content/Characters

~Uninstallation~
1. Delete Toddler.xnb and Toddler_girl.xnb in Content/Characters
2. Replace with backups
